budget.metric: relative error of the simulated chip compression ratio h / h_chip (mean chip thickness for segmented chips)
budget.note: Measured chip thickness scatters by about 10 % even in careful work (Ducobu 2017) and by 10-30 % for manually measured sections (Klippel 2022; spread estimated here from repeats such as V0096-V0098). Calibrated FE models reach 14-15 % (Loeschner 2025, Qiu 2019); twenty JC sets give -5 % to more than +44 % (Ducobu 2017).

Jaspers & Dautzenberg (2002) constants as stated by Burns et al. 2012 Eq. (1.2), with Tr = 20 C and Tf = 1490 C; also used by xiu-2019-1045-grinding-fe Table 4. Burns et al. report that FE simulations with this set under-predict the peak tool-chip temperature by hundreds of C and that rapidly heated 1045 is stiffer below the eutectoid (723 C). Alternative: Murugesan & Jung 2019 (Materials 12:609) fitted A 50.1, B 176.1 for hot forming at 1223 K reference, not suitable for cutting. The Jaspers & Dautzenberg original (J. Mater. Process. Technol., 2002) could not be read in the second research round either (paywalled; no open thesis copy found), so the set is confirmed only through Burns et al. and xiu-2019-1045-grinding-fe.
20 C; Table 1 gives 7850 (20 C) falling to 7649 (1000 C)
